name: Brite Creek Farm
tagline: Brite Creek Farm, Grass fed beef delivery to your door
description: Brite Creek Farm is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 20101 Banducci Rd, CA. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
